text.tspan: 1. Power-up (all logic low, DAC EEPROM 0 V): mic input, +40 dB, normal polarity, HPF out, phantom off, VCA muted.
2. Firmware mutes (DAC 0) for ~10 ms around PAD / select / polarity / HPF changes, ~1.5 s around P48 changes.
3. K1: confirm COM = pins 3/6 against Omron internal-connection drawing before layout.
4. U6 (AS2180) exposed pad: leave unconnected until confirmed in the Alfa datasheet.
5. 0.1% thin film: R1/R2 (matched), R8, R9, R21-R24, R33, R36, R40-R44. C0G: all <=100n non-polar.
Fixed gain (VCA later does all gain variation)
All low = mic, normal, HPF out.
LED lights only when P48_LCV AND MIC_SEL_LCV
through R1/R2 into C3/C4 (~0.3 s); firmware mutes
the VCA ~1.5 s around every phantom change.
DAC 0 V = mute (-79 dB), 2.0475 V (code 4095) = +28 dB, 26 mdB/LSB.
Drift +/-0.035 dB, 10-45 C. MFB fc 133 Hz.
Relay off: COM-NC, RG 60.4R, +40 dB (normal mic).
VERIFY COM = pins 3/6 on Omron drawing before
layout. NO/NC swapped = invert PAD_LCV in FW.
Keep RG loop short and symmetric (<few pF).
GAIN VCA (AS2180: -30 to +26 dB, mute at DAC 0 V)
R1/R2: 6.81k 0.1% matched pair, 2010 (0.34 W each into a shorted input).
D1-D4: Schottky rated >=10 A surge (TI INA849 phantom application circuit).
C3/C4: + toward the XLR. Pre gain +40 dB (relay off) or +20 dB (PAD_LCV high).
